No. The land-change method could not evaluate ASSET-J. The status is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because of missing coverage: the source data this property needs has not been prepared, so no observation was made. Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020 and MGAP 2021 are all marked unavailable, and the observations list is empty.

This means the result says nothing about whether tree-cover loss occurred after the 2020-12-31 baseline (2021–2025 interval, whole property boundary). It does not show loss, and it does not show no loss. It also supports no compliance finding, such as EUDR compliant, non-compliant or deforestation-free.

The property's area is also not recorded (null). To get an answer, the missing source coverage would need to be prepared and the analysis re-run.
